metric_name: Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) schemes permitted and constructed for A4
context_text: Completed construction of A4 MAR.；Motheo (operational) Five Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR)13 schemes permitted and constructed to support A4 mine development. A4 dewatering expansion program developed with completion expected in FY26. Five monitoring boreholes drilled. Precipitation during the wet season led to an average SWL increase of 10 metres impacting the A4 region and resulted in sitewide groundwater recharge. A4 dewatering and water transfer infrastructure to T3 is operational.
label: Fully Supported
rationale_short: FY25 Highlights中的“Completed construction of A4 MAR”被后文“Five Managed Aquifer Recharge (MAR) schemes permitted and constructed”直接且具体地量化支撑。
